description: Find meeting slots that fall inside working hours for every participant timezone, skipping weekends and public holidays, with per-participant local times. Use when you need to find meeting times inside everyone's working hours across time zones, skipping weekends and public holidays. Example input: ?timezones=America/New_York,Europe/London&date=2026-11-24.

countries.description: Comma list of ISO alpha-2 codes aligned with timezones, used to skip public holidays

timezones.description: Comma list of IANA timezones; the first is the organizer whose local day anchors the search

name: global_scheduling_composite
